# Design System Sync

Use when adding or changing UI components, tokens, themes or responsive behavior.

## Procedure

1. Locate the canonical token and component definitions before editing a page.
2. Reuse tokens for color, typography, spacing, radius, shadows and motion.
3. Update shared components when the behavior is cross-page; avoid local overrides.
4. Verify hover, focus, disabled, loading, error and empty states.
5. Check mobile-first responsive behavior, dark mode and contrast.
6. Validate affected screens visually and run existing UI checks.

Prefer one canonical component over parallel variants that drift.
